adaptation.adaptation_label_source: ground-truth class labels from DatasetNinja JSON box annotations, carried by manifest.splits[Split.ADAPTATION].samples (target domain, labelled)
adaptation.class_weights_and_sampler_source: augmented TRAIN tensor (Kaggle TRAIN + selected labelled ADAPTATION); when --adaptation-samples 0 this is the original Kaggle TRAIN tensor
adaptation.default_choice: --adaptation-samples defaults to 0 so a bare invocation reproduces the prior QNN recipe exactly. The matched classical mixed protocol uses 50 labelled Ninja adaptation samples (qsvc_target_adaptation_per_run=50), so pass --adaptation-samples 50 to match it; this is recorded in provenance.

disjointness_assertion.note: Selected ADAPTATION samples share no source-image/group, sample_id, content_hash or path with the capped OOD_TEST split.

adaptation.recipe_note: QHEAD-D02: labelled ADAPTATION-split target-domain samples are mixed into TRAIN only, through the same frozen feature loader; ID_VAL and OOD_TEST loaders are untouched and OOD_TEST is never used as a mixing source. Source-image (group) disjointness from OOD_TEST is asserted. This makes the training budget matched to the classical mixed arm; it is NOT a claim of improved OOD generalisation. Selection is a seeded, class-balanced crop-level sample of manifest.splits[Split.ADAPTATION].samples (one Sample = one Ninja bounding-box crop). The classical mixed arm draws whole source-image groups via _draw_group_stratified, so the two arms are budget-matched but NOT identical sample sets; do not treat them as paired draws.
adaptation.sample_selection_scope: Selection is a seeded, class-balanced crop-level sample of manifest.splits[Split.ADAPTATION].samples (one Sample = one Ninja bounding-box crop). The classical mixed arm draws whole source-image groups via _draw_group_stratified, so the two arms are budget-matched but NOT identical sample sets; do not treat them as paired draws.
adaptation.selection_method: seeded shuffle of canonical sample_id order, class-balanced; deterministic and input-order independent

backbone.name: imagenet
backbone.note: Feature backbone is frozen (no weights are updated during training).

calibration.note: Calibration was fitted on ID_VAL only. A validation-only gain is NOT evidence of improved OOD performance; OOD metrics are reported separately from a distinct, untouched split. Temperature scaling and a constant class logit shift preserve the within-class logit ordering and cannot manufacture class separation that the representation lacks.

claim_boundary: Any temperature/logit adjustment was fitted on ID_VAL only; OOD labels were never used for fitting or for checkpoint selection. No OOD improvement is inferred from a validation-only gain. The adaptation step mixed labelled ADAPTATION-split samples into TRAIN only with ood_labels_used=false; this matches the classical mixed training budget and is not an OOD-generalisation claim.
